scope: Exact repository-wide byte maps returned by the official GitHub Languages API for the official mirror of the canonical WineHQ GitLab project. Counts include vendored/framework components and build tools; they do not measure only the Wine-specific modifications.

records.evidence: Exact repository-wide byte totals returned by the official GitHub Languages endpoint on 2026-10-16. C is the largest reported category. The official GitHub mirror's main commit SHA matched the canonical GitLab main commit SHA at review time; totals include large upstream runtime/class-library components and tooling and are not a measure of Wine-specific code.
